description: Dobór anteny w urządzeniu is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PRONAL Sp. z o.o. Sp.k. Antena w urządzeniu radiowym jest bardzo ważnym elementem i generalnie to ona decyduje o sile nadawania i jakości odbioru. Zazwyczaj nie da się odrobić strat mocy nadawania źle dobranej anteny poprzez zwiększanie mocy dostarczanej do anteny. Coverage: PRONAL Sp. z o.o. Sp.k. The publisher named on the listing is PRONAL Sp. z o.o. Sp.k. Its keywords include LoRa. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
